nodes.name: Daily 9AM Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 09:00 in the workflow timezone (Africa/Cairo).

nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Configure Telegram credential. Optionally restrict Chat IDs to your own chat.

nodes.name: Get Today Events
nodes.notes: Configure Google Calendar credential. Calendar ID 'primary' = your main calendar; change if your tasks live in another calendar.

nodes.name: Send Daily Email
nodes.notes: Configure Gmail credential AND replace the placeholder recipient address in 'To'.

nodes.name: Mark Task Completed
nodes.notes: Configure Google Calendar credential. Updates only description + title; event is kept.
